data.one_liner: Display customizable snackbars dropping down from the top of the screen
data.what_it_does: Provides a convenient function to display overlay-based notifications sliding down from the top of the screen. Supports custom widgets, built-in success, info, and error layouts, swipe-to-dismiss, and persistent snackbars.
use_when: You need to inform users of errors, warnings, or successes via a top-anchored banner.
You want a drop-in replacement for bottom snackbars positioned at the top of the app.
avoid_when: You need complex local or push notification management backed by system services.
You prefer purely declarative state-driven snackbar management.
strengths: Simple function-based API similar to showDialog or showTopSnackBar.
Supports custom widgets or included pre-styled CustomSnackBar components.
Provides advanced options like persistent snackbars and multi-directional swipe dismissal.
weaknesses: Relies on imperative function calls rather than a declarative builder or state provider.
